actions.title: Launch newest ROM in mGBA
actions.description: Open the most recently modified .gba ROM in this repository; does not rebuild.
actions.command: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import shutil, subprocess, sys; roms = list(Path(".").rglob("*.gba")); rom = max(roms, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime_ns) if roms else sys.exit("No .gba ROM found; build one first."); emulator = shutil.which("mgba") or shutil.which("mGBA"); subprocess.run([emulator, str(rom.resolve())] if emulator else ["open", "-a", "mGBA", str(rom.resolve())], check=True)'
